sections.heading: Underlying Contract and Nature of Obligation
sections.body: This Contract Performance Bond is issued at the request of the Principal in respect of Work Order No. SBWWA/STR/2025/112 dated May 28, 2025 for the supply of TMT reinforcement bars (Fe 500D) and structural steel sections for the raw water intake well and clear water reservoir works. The Surety guarantees the due performance by the Principal of its obligations under the said Work Order and undertakes to pay the Obligee, on first written demand, any amount up to the Bond Amount stated in the Schedule on account of default by the Principal.

sections.heading: Conditions of the Bond
sections.body: 1. The liability of the Surety shall not in any case exceed the Bond Amount stated in the Schedule. 2. The Bond shall not be discharged by any variation in the terms of the Work Order, extension of time or forbearance granted by the Obligee to the Principal. 3. This Bond is irrevocable during its validity and shall not be cancelled for non-payment of premium once issued. 4. The Bond is issued under the Surety Insurance Contracts guidelines of the IRDAI and is subject to the indemnity agreement executed by the Principal in favour of the Surety.

sections.heading: Claim Lodgement Procedure
sections.body: Any demand under this Bond must be made in writing by the Obligee, signed by an officer not below the rank of Executive Engineer, and lodged at the issuing office of the Surety within the validity period or within a claim period of thirty days thereafter. The demand shall quote the Bond Certificate No. and be accompanied by a statement of the default. Payment shall be released within fifteen working days of receipt of a compliant demand, without reference to any dispute between the Principal and the Obligee.

sections.heading: Verification and Grievance Redressal
sections.body: Authenticity of this certificate may be verified by sending an SMS with the certificate number to 56677 or at the verification portal of the Surety. For grievances, contact the Grievance Redressal Officer at grievance@gangavalleygi.example.in or toll free 1800-120-4471. If unresolved within 14 days, the matter may be escalated to the Bima Bharosa platform or the Insurance Ombudsman having jurisdiction.

sections.heading: Jurisdiction
sections.body: This Bond shall be governed by the laws of India and the courts at Raipur, Chhattisgarh alone shall have jurisdiction in any matter arising hereunder. Stamp duty has been paid by way of e-stamp as per the Chhattisgarh Stamp Act.
